states: Follow-up receipt for the merge of origin/main (7f45148d15) into this branch: the hook's final content differs from both parents only by main's own removals of summaryStats (#2690) and the loadCorrelations supporting read (#2677).

Embedded production builds (vite build into internal/api/frontend-modern/dist, go build) of origin/main 7f45148d15 and of this merged tree (1a48d27aa0), run on pulse-dev because local memory pressure refused heavy work; each on a private DEMO_MODE mock stack with a fresh data dir; the same Playwright script ran against both at both widths.

Patrol load with one served active finding (page.route on /api/ai/patrol/findings and /api/ai/unified/findings), Activity > Finding options and history, Resolve or dismiss > Open in Assistant: the Pulse Assistant drawer opens with the finding attached on both builds; no console errors on either.

Tab hidden then shown (visibilitychange) and the stale-data banner forced by failing GET /api/settings/ai on reload: 'Patrol could not refresh' shows on both builds and Retry clears it on both, at both widths (state-based waits; a first run with fixed 5 s sleeps missed the banner on the loaded host for timing reasons).

Across the whole run both builds hit the same set of /api endpoints; per-endpoint counts differ by one to three only for timer-driven attention, pending-action and active-alert polls, which this change does not touch.

Dist proof on pulse-dev: 187 files each side; after normalising chunk hashes, SRI strings and short identifiers, only the removed hook code differs in AIIntelligence.js, the unused pulse_patrol constant drops out of aiChat.js, and index.js reorders the same preload list.
interactions: Demo auto sign-in; on /patrol open the Activity tab and 'Finding options and history', expand the served finding, open 'Resolve or dismiss', click 'Open in Assistant', close the drawer.
Dispatch visibilitychange hidden then visible; reload with GET /api/settings/ai failing, wait for the banner, restore the route and click Retry, wait for the banner to clear.
Desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844 contexts; screenshots of the Patrol page, Finding options and history, the Assistant drawer and the stale-data banner inspected.
